summary: Verified Chrome extension bug fix for Lyft/Greenhouse iframe autofill. Ran both Node.js unit tests (test_extension_lyft.js + test_popup_aggregation.js) — both PASS with exit code 0. Verified manifest.json in source and in packaged zip is v1.2.0 with content_scripts.all_frames: true. Backend /api/health returns 200 — no regression.
critical_code_review_comments: content.js exposes window.__mccHandleAutoFill + window.__mccHasFormFields correctly; hasFormFields() early-exit sets frameHadForm=false and returns empty arrays — verified.

popup.js aggregateFrameResults correctly (a) de-dupes across frames, (b) suppresses 'no file input' skipped entries when the same base name was filled elsewhere, (c) returns 'No form fields detected' error when no frame has forms, (d) ignores null frame results (restricted frames) — all 4 scenarios pass.
manifest.json now declares content_scripts with all_frames: true — this was the root cause fix for Lyft's Greenhouse iframe embedding.

Note (informational, not a bug): The lyft test logs a jsdom-specific 'Failed to set the files property... not of type FileList' error during file upload simulation. This is a jsdom limitation (jsdom doesn't support programmatic FileList assignment) not an extension bug — real Chrome supports it via DataTransfer. The test still PASSES because the assertion only verifies file inputs were DISCOVERED (not silently skipped as 'no file input'). The result shows the failed uploads under 'failed' array (correct behavior) rather than the previous false-positive '✓ Resume (Optimized for this job)' bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chrome extension tests are Node.js/JSDOM based, located at /app/browser-extension/tests/. Run with `cd /app/browser-extension/tests && node <testfile>.js`. node_modules is symlinked to /tmp/node_modules (contains jsdom). Extension cannot be tested via Playwright headless Chromium — always use the Node unit tests. The lyft test's file-upload TypeError from jsdom is expected and does not fail the assertions.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Lyft embeds Greenhouse form in iframe; manifest lacked content_scripts (only used chrome.scripting.executeScript which defaults to top frame only), so content script never reached iframe → nothing filled. Also popup.js unconditionally reported 'Resume (Optimized for this job)' as filled even when upload failed → false-positive ✓ shown to user. Fixes: (1) manifest.json content_scripts with all_frames: true, (2) executeScript now uses allFrames: true and calls window.__mccHandleAutoFill in every frame, (3) aggregateFrameResults dedupes and only reports actual successes. Verified via 2 Node/JSDOM unit tests — all scenarios pass.
